objective.text: Retrieve an inserted identifier without assuming Query Builder applies Eloquent model events or timestamps.

difficulty.rationale: Separate raw table insertion from model timestamp and observer behavior.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: records has nullable timestamps. Record has a creating observer that increments a counter. The table starts empty. What follows DB::table("records")->insertGetId(["name" => "new"])?

options.text: It returns a Record model and runs creating before the insert.
options.rationale: insertGetId returns the identifier, not an Eloquent model with lifecycle hooks.
options.misconception: insertGetId returns the identifier, not an Eloquent model with lifecycle hooks.

options.text: It returns the id and runs the observer once because the table name matches Record.
options.rationale: Query Builder does not infer a model class from the table name.
options.misconception: Query Builder does not infer a model class from the table name.

options.text: It returns the generated id; the observer is not called and omitted timestamps remain null.
options.rationale: Query Builder inserts directly and retrieves the key without constructing or saving an Eloquent model.

options.text: It returns the id and automatically fills both timestamps using Record’s defaults.
options.rationale: Eloquent timestamp behavior does not apply to this direct table operation.
options.misconception: Eloquent timestamp behavior does not apply to this direct table operation.
